name: Little Strays
description:
In a desolate world where only the fittest survive, you step into the paws of a brave cat determined to make a difference. While the streets whisper of danger and abandonment, you listen and navigate the abandoned warehouse in search of stranded and frightened kittens. Your mission is clear: find food, help the helpless and lead the lost to safety. Every turn brings new challenges, but with a strong will and a caring spirit, you can do anything to protect those who need it most!

The game also features a split-screen mode where two players can battle it out to rescue as many kittens as possible. Team up or go head to head to make this survival adventure even more exciting!
